title: Cognitive Bias Detection Using Advanced Prompt Engineering

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the accuracy of LLMs (Mixtral 7x8B, Llama 3 70B) using structured prompt engineering to detect six specific cognitive biases and logical fallacies (Straw Man, False Causality, Circular Reasoning, Mirror Imaging, Confirmation Bias, and Hidden Assumptions) across a diverse, human-annotated dataset of user-generated open-source text.
